description: Creates a real Luxor plastic business card order for the user and returns an order reference, the exact quote and (when online payment is enabled) a Stripe checkout_url for the user to pay. A human designer then emails a proof; nothing is printed until the user approves it. Confirm the material, quantity, total price and shipping address with the user before calling. design_notes must contain the text for the card (name, title, phone, email, website) and any style/logo instructions.

artwork_urls.description: Optional public HTTPS links to logo/artwork files

design_notes.description: Exact card text and design instructions

stock.description: clear = transparent PVC with white-ink backing; frosted = translucent matte; solid = opaque white (full color)

template_url.description: Optional design page URL from search_designs

name: create_order
title: Place an order (returns a secure checkout link)
